'Instant - {r}, destroy Seeker's Gilet: Prevent the next 1 damage that would be dealt to your hero this turn. Opt 1'

The {r} is the ACTIVATION COST and the destroy is a COST, not an effect: both have to be paid before the ability resolves, and modelling either as an effect would let the ability be activated without paying. PREVENT_DAMAGE with no damage_type is correct here -- the printed text names no type, so the shield absorbs any (tests/test_prevention_damage_type.py guards the opposite mistake). Opt is CR 8.5.x and has its own effect type; it is NOT a printed keyword on this card, so it is authored.
